name: Permanencia Transitoria (Tourist Entry)

requirements.blocker_text: Enters Chile without intent to establish residence, for tourism or recreation purposes.
Lawful means of support ('medios lícitos de subsistencia') for the duration of the stay.
A visa is required for some nationalities before travel; fees vary by nationality (single-entry vs. multiple-entry) and are set by a nationality-specific fee table not fully extracted in this pass.

evidence_required.document: Proof of lawful means of support

sources.title: consulado.gob.cl (Chilean Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular portal) -- visa information for entering Chile: Permanencia Transitoria permits up to 90 days for tourism without settlement intent; requires lawful means of support; visa-required vs. visa-exempt status and fees vary by nationality, selected via a dropdown not fully captured in this pass

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Chile). Modeled PUBLISHED since the core 90-day framework and no-settlement-intent basis are tier-1 (Chile's own consular portal). Exact visa fees and the full visa-exempt nationality list were not extracted (the source page requires a per-nationality dropdown selection rather than listing a static table) -- not stated here rather than guessed. General note that applies across this whole Chile build: Chile's 2021 Migration Law (Ley 21.325) restructured the system around a single 'Residencia Temporal' permit with 15 named subcategories rather than separately branded visa types -- 'Permanencia Transitoria' (this file) sits outside that residence-permit structure as the short-stay, non-residence entry category.
